description: Get bounded, source-backed property context for a commune: asking prices and rents per m2 with samples, quoted rent charges, the share of sale adverts with a price cut, the registered sale price, source dates and unknown states. Link pageUrl when sharing the result.

commune.description: Luxembourg commune slug or name (e.g. 'luxembourg', 'esch-sur-alzette'). City quarters have a different scope and must not be treated as communes.

locale.description: Response locale: en, fr, de, lu (Luxembourgish), pt (default: en; 'lb' is a deprecated alias for 'lu')

name: get_market_context
title: Get Market Context
